title: Fear Anonymous
overview: Jack Miller operates a self help group that focuses on fear and trauma. This story takes place in one of his meetings he holds at the community center. Everyone in the group has a different story about why they have fear in their lives. Rick seems to stumble upon this group of different people and decides to sit in. The stories range from domestic infidelity, paranormal activity, witches, cannibalism and even rape. None of the stories come close to what Rick brings with him. This is a anthology that will keep you on your feet.
